name: Barbarian
overview: The term 'Barbarian' in Scripture often refers to foreigners or those outside the Jewish and Greek cultural spheres, as seen when Paul describes his obligation to both Greeks and Barbarians, wise and unwise (Romans 1:14). The account in Acts 28 reveals that these so-called barbarians were capable of kindness, welcoming Paul and his companions despite cultural differences. Furthermore, Colossians 3:11 emphasizes that in Christ, distinctions such as Barbarian or Greek are abolished, highlighting the unity believers share regardless of ethnic background.
